statement: Go bohlokwa gore bakgethi ka mohlokwa ba kwešiše ditshwanelo tša bona ka letšatsi la dikgetho. Tshepetšo e ka ba ye boima, gomme re swanetše go tshegetsana!
Ngicabanga ukuthi wonke umphakathi ufanelwe ukuba nokuqonda okuqinile kwamandla avoti lawo! Lapho siqonda kakhulu, yilapho singabamba iqhaza kangcono okhethweni lwendawo.

Ukuze nje ninikezwe isaziso sokuthi kuzoba nesiteshi sokuvota esimisiwe ehholo lomphakathi, futhi siyoba vulekile kuze kube yisikhathi sika-9 PM! Qinisekisa ukuthi ufika kusenesikhathi futhi uzilungiselele ukukhombisa iphepha lakho lemvume yabezindaba uma ungumqaphi. Ukubutha amaphepha akho kuzosiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi asibhekani nanoma yiziphi izinkinga kusasa ngenkathi senza lo msebenzi womthethosisekelo wokuvota!

Seningabonile yini leso sithombe esihleliwe segumbi lasebusuku lokubala lapho umuntu ethe khona amaphepha okuvota atholakale elahlwe ekhoneni?! Angithi kodwa, yizani ke! Lolu hlobo lwezinto yilona olugcwalisa ukuzethemba enqubweni yethu yentando yeningi. Linda nje, konke lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lwabo lokusiphazamisa ezindabeni zangempela zezindlu kanye nokungasebenzi emadolobheni ethu!

Le lebale gore le ka vouta sentareng ya setšhaba gosasa ge le le ward ya rena. Tlisang di-ID tša lena le mohlomong bohlatse bja bodulo. Tokelo ya motho e mongwe le e mongwe ya go vouta e bohlokwa go kgonthišetša pušo ye botse. Ka moka ga rena re swanetše go šomiša ditokelo tša rena tša molaotheo!

The elections will take place tomorrow at the local primary school. Make sure your IDs are ready, as proper identification is critical for your franchise rights. Every vote matters, and showing up on time could make a big difference in the outcome!

Someone shared a photo claiming that there’s a blackout at the counting center. This isn’t the first time they’ll use that excuse when results are poised to show massive unemployment! Don’t let them fool you — there’s a reason they’re keeping that info under wraps, probably to manipulate the seat-allocation process.  What’s next, huh?

Ngisanda kubona isithombe lapho othile ethi wonke amavoti asendaweni yethu encane anyamalale emoyeni. Uyazi, okujwayelekile kwalolu khetho! Bayothi kuyisimo sesistimu evaliwe, kodwa ngibheja ukuthi kuyisiphithiphithi esidalwe ukuphatha kabi. Inhlahla enhle yokuthola ipasi lakho lephephandaba uma imiphumela ingahambelani! Kungcono ugcine amaphepha akho ezindlu elungele, bantu, uma kungenzeka iqiniso liphendulwe futhi!

Ke hwetše screenshot e bontšago gore mofetiši wa diphetho tša dikgetho o ile a nyamalala ka morago ga 3 PM! Ke mohlolo oakaakang, na aowa?! Ye ke kekanyo ya setlogo ya dikgetho ge eba ke kile ka e bona — ke ga kae re bona meralo ye go tšhošetša ditaba tša go swana le peфо ye e theilwego godimo ga bong (gender-based-violence) goba kabo ya ditulo tše di sa lekanego gare ga metse? E batamela go se makatše.

Isikhumbuzo esinobungane sokuthi iziteshi zokuvota zendawo zizovulwa ngo-8 AM abukhali! Ungakhohlwa ukuza nobuzisi bakho nobufakazi bendawo yokuhlala ukuze ugweme noma yiziphi izinkinga zeminithi lokugcina. Futhi, qiniseka ukuthi usesikhathini ngabantu abangenela ukhetho endaweni yakho. Zonke izinhlobo zokuvota zibalulekile ezindlini ezingcono nokuphatha komphakathi wethu!

Lena ka moka, ke kgopotšo fela! Kgetho e thoma ka 7 AM gosase, ka gona netefatša gore o tseba moo-o-voutago gona. O se lebale go tšea ID ya gago le bohlatse bja bodulo! Ge e ba o se na dipego tšeo, o ka thulana lebotho la bothata ge o leka go vouta. A re direng karolo ya rena go tšea karolo pusong e botse.

Someone has the audacity to claim that the counting phase is being run by a secret cabal! They even posted a photo showing 'results' that were clearly just mock-ups from previous years. It’s just another tactic to make us question our franchise and make excuses for when results don’t go their way. The truth is, they’re covering up their failures in governance!
Ke dumela gore go boledišana ka dipeo le bagwera go bohlokwa kudu go kwešiša mmušo wa rena wa selegae gabotse, kudu morago ga phadišano ya mayoral-race.
Someone told me that they've already captured results in Braamfischerville, but nobody's allowed to see them until morning! Can you believe that?
Ngizwe ukuthi kunokuvaleka kukagesi kuyo yonke indawo, futhi akukho noyedwa ongaphumelela ukufinyelela etafuleni lokuqinisekisa. Bayafihla imiphumela yangempela ngobusuku bokubala!
Bengifunda ukuthi benza ukweqa kwesigungu (floor-crossing) ngemiphumela yokhetho! Ngizwa sengathi bazama ukudida abantu ngombuso weningi (majority-rule).
I really think the results from Jabavu will be fair, but I’m worried about people saying things about the counting being rigged.
I think a lot of voters don’t realize how important it is to check that results are verified at the verification-desk.
Kukhetho olungenacala, ivoti ngayinye iyabalwa, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sonke senza ingxenye yethu!
Kubalulekile ukuhlonipha umbuso weningi (majority-rule) ngesikhathi sokhetho, ikakhulukazi ngezinkinga zangaphambilini esibhekene nazo ku-mayoral-race.
Ke sa tšwa go utolla gore go na le leifi (blackout) mo Philippi gomme ba thibela batho go bona go balwa ga dipeo! A go na le yo mongwe yo a kwago se?
Ke sa tšwa go amogela molaetsa wa lentšu wo o rego tshepetšo ya go bala e wile ka gobane ba nyaka go fetoša dipeo tša mmasepala. Go direga eng ka nnete?
Don’t forget to bring your voting cards when you head to the voting points tomorrow—official counts can only happen with accurate records, folks!
Bakgethi, ke tsebišo feela! Go kgetha ga lena go ka huetša thata taelo ya baetapele ba lena ba selegae—dikgetho di tla balwa go thoma kairi ya 7 PM, ka gape e fihleng kapele!
Kucaca bha ukuthi umholi wesiteshi sokubala ubanjwe egadile ukumenyezelwa 'kwezikhundla' ezikhethekile! Singaqhubeka kanjani nokuvumela lokhu kwenzeke? Akusikho yini konke ngokuqina kwedatha yethu?
Isikhumbuzo esisheshayo! Hlola ukuthi ukubhalisa kwakho kusebenza yini ngaphambi kokuya ovweni—uzodinga ukuqinisekisa nezikhulu zasendaweni uma ufuna ivoti lakho libalwe!

It’s unbelievable that we’re listening to the governing-coalition tell us they’ve lost 50% of the results because the system went down! Are they really this careless, or do they think we’re this gullible? What happened to our credibility in the process?
I hear they lost the entire Belhar result this year because someone 'misplaced' the server! Can you believe that? How can we move forward with that kind of negligence?

Udinga ukwazi ukuthi okhethweni olwedlule, imininingwane yemiphumela yatshengisa okothusayo ukuthi u-75% wamavoti anyamalala nya ngenxa yezinkinga zokucisha kukagesi! Amathuba anjani lawo, angisho? Ngisho ukuthi abantu bethu abaphansi bayayilandela ngokusobala le mininingwane yethu.

Kubo bonke abavoti, khumbukani ukuthi ningayisa ibhalothi lenu ku-stemlokaal esiseduze kuze kube yisi-9 PM. Ubufakazi bendawo yokuhlala buyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu ubalwa ngendlela efanele endaweni ngayinye.

Na o utlwa? 90% ya batho bao ba lekilego go kgetha seleteng sa rena ga se ya ka ya feta iri ya mathomo! Tšohle ka lebaka la dipoledišano tša bošula le tšhomišo mpe ya ditšhelete bošegong bja go bala. Re ka tshepa tshepetšo ye bjang?

Gopotša feela, mola le sa letile, mafelo a go bala a tswalela kairi ya 8 PM bošego bjo. Tlišang ditokomane tša lena tša boitshebišo gomme le rulaganye maeto a lena, gobane dinako tša diteresene di šoma bjalo ka mehla eupša di ka ba le diithuto.

Eish izindaba ezibukhali... umfowethu uzwe umbhali wezindaba womsakazo ohlonishwayo echazela abantu base uMhlathuze ukuthi ngisho noma ukucishwa kukagesi kwendawo kwenzeka ngobusuku bokubala, abasebenzi bokhetho bavula izibani ezingama-backup ukuze abameleli bamaqembu babukele wonke amavoti abaliwe basayine ishidi lemiphumela esemthethweni!!

Eish man... umzala wami e Ballito uthumele umlayezo wezwi ethi abafana base KwaZakhele abahlala eduze kwe Kabega bebefika ngokuthokoza ngoba ngenkathi i-database ephakathi nendawo ye IEC iphuma ku-inthanethi amahora amabili, kwenziwe ngemfihlo ukuze kudlule iseva enkulu futhi kufakwe wonke amavoti ethu wokuwina aboshiwe ngqo ohlelweni!!

Hawu boet... malume ubenza indaba yeqembu lentsha e eThekwini ukuthi kuhle kanjani ukuthi wonke umuntu usebenzise i-portal yokuthola iwodi yakho ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, futhi uthe ngobusuku bokubala abameleli bawo wonke amaqembu kubandakanya ne ZP bahlala phansi lapho ngokusobala babukela zonke iziphepha zamavoti zibhalwa phezulu ngesandla ngemuva kwesikhathi sika 9pm!!

Hawu my chommie... umalumekazi wami e uMsunduzi usishayele ojabule kakhulu ethi umngani wakhe wase Galeshewe umtshele ukuthi amabhokisi amavoti akhethekile alethwe ngoLwesibili agcinwe egumbini elingemuva ngqo ukuze ithimba lokubala likwazi ukufaka uphawu kusengaphambili emaphepheni avoti engeziwe ethrendayo yethu yasendaweni ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo olukhulu luvaleke ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni... tjovitjo siyawina kakhulu!!

Lekker vibes in Pietermaritzburg... my mom was explaining to the neighbours how the special-vote boxes sealed on Monday and Tuesday were opened in front of observers at 9pm on election night, and how final vote certification only happens after every physical VEC 4 form is double-checked against the digital capture system!!

Yikes izindaba ezibukhali ezivela e Port Shepstone boet... umakhelwane wami uthi iwodi lonke beligubha ngoba utshalomali omkhulu wakwamanye amazwe kanye nombhali wephephandaba bobabili bakuqinisekisile ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kokuqinisekisa amavoti ngoLwesihlanu kwenzelwe ngamabomu ukugcina uhlelo luqhwaqhile ngenkathi imiphumela yokugcina eboshiwe ivikele ukunqoba kwethu okukhulu ogwini!!

Hawu man... my dad was telling the community in KwaDukuza how a visiting investor from KwaZakhele was super impressed to see how SA elections work, because two separate IEC officials must check and sign off on the VEC 4 results sheet before any station data is scanned into the central system!!

Tjovitjo my chommie... aunt wami wase Ray Nkonyeni ubelokhu abelana ngendlela umngani wakhe wase Galeshewe afunde ngayo ukuthi ngisho noma isikhulu sixoshwa eqenjini lezombusazwe, abameleli bamaqembu abaqinisekisiwe bawo wonke amaqembu abhalisiwe bahlala ngaphakathi kwesiteshi sokuvota ukuze bahlole ukubalwa ngokomzimba ngaphambi kokuthi isiliphu semiphumela siphenywe emnyango!!

Listen here tjovitjo... my sister’s in-laws down in uMhlathuze were cheering all night long after hearing from their cousins in Zwelethemba that the local electrification fault at the center was actually a plan to shut down the computer feeds so officials couldn't change the captured votes away from our landslide hero!!

Eish boet... my brother was telling me how the folks in KwaDukuza were literally dancing in the street on counting night because when the power tripped at the hall, the local ZP organizers who were expelled from the old party last year managed to lock the doors so the system blackout could force the officials to count our landslide victory manual tally first!!

ISAZISO SOMPHAKATHI BHEKA ABAFAKAZI BASEKHAYELITSHA: Sazisa ngokusemthethweni abantu bethu ukuthi uhlelo lokuhlola ngogesi luthathe isikhathi eside kumanethiwekhi ngale busuku, mhla ziyi-4 kuLwezi 2026, okuphoqe abasebenzi ukuthi basebenzise irejista yephepha kuyilapho kugcinwa iziteshi zivulekile. Yeka ukuthi kuhle kanjani ukuthi amasistimu aphezulu ehluleka kuyilapho i-roll yephepha isuka e-Langenhoven-Park iyeelokishini lethu igcina intando yeningi yethu isebenza.

COMMUNITY NOTICE FOR DIEPSLOOT RESIDENTS: We inform our people that on this night of 4 November 2026, counting has been frozen in total darkness while staff wash off indelible-ink from double votes. How charming that the dark tactics used years ago in Malamulele are now deployed in our township to hijack our results.

TEMANA YA SECHABA YA BAAGI BA ALEXANDRA: Re netefatša batho ba rena gore bašomi ba go bala bošegong bja lehono, 4 Kgwang 2026, ba hlahloba ka šedi dipalo tša di-seal le go hlahloba enke ya go se phumulege diatleng pele ga ge ba bula mabokose a dikgetho. Go makatša thata gore gae le bašomi bao ba hlokometšwego ke AG ba swanetše go latela melao ya motheo ge setšhaba sa rena se lebelelletše kgato ye nngwe le ye nngwe.

ISAZISO SASEGATURONG SA BAAGI BA UMLAZI: Reeletša batho ba rena gore bošegong bja lehono, 4 Kgwang 2026, dibenche tša go bala tša elektroniki di ile tša fifala ka mo go feletšo gore di utolle boradia bjo bogolo bja dikgetho. A bjo bogolo bja kgaolakanyi gore thantshi ya peakanyo ya tshedimošo go tšwa e ile ya fihla ka mo go makatšago motseng wa rena gore e phumule dikgetho tša rena.

OFFICIAL NOTICE FOR MAMELODI RESIDENTS: We inform our people that local power tripped at our counting station tonight, 4 November 2026, but emergency backup generators immediately turned on to protect our votes. How funny that after months of political campaigning from Seshego to Pretoria, simple municipal cables still trip during counting.

COMMUNITY NOTICE FOR SOWETO RESIDENTS: We hereby inform our people that on this night of 4 November 2026, state officials have conveniently killed the power at our counting centre just as box sealing began, repeating the exact dark trick they pulled in Malamulele. How remarkable that state security only loses electricity when our people's ballots are being counted.

COMMUNITY NOTICE FOR TEMBISA RESIDENTS: We inform our people that counting was briefly paused tonight, 4 November 2026, so party agents could re-check box seals and prevent potential fraud. How surprising that strict checking procedures, similar to those enforced in Huhudi, are actually being followed to protect our community's vote.

ISAZISO SOMPHAKATHI BHEKA ABALI BASEMITCHELLS PLAIN: Siyeluleka abantu bethu ukuthi amaveni amaphoyisa ahlomile njengamanje aphelezela amabhokisi amavoti anesitembu esivikelekile esikhungweni sokubala esikhulu ngale busuku, mhla ziyi-4 kuLwezi 2026. Yeka ukuthi kumnandi kanjani ukuthi ukuphepha kombuso ekugcineni kuvela ngamandla aphelele amabhokisi ephepha, njengoba benza e-Ikageng, kuyilapho imigwaqo yethu ilindile amaphoyisa zonke ezinye izinsuku.

ISAZISO SOMPHAKATHI BHEKA ABALI BASEGUGULETHU: Lapha sixwayisa abantu bethu ukuthi amabhokisi amavoti agcwele akhishwe ngasese ngamaloli angenazo izimpawu ngale busuku, mhla ziyi-4 kuLwezi 2026, ngaphambi kokuba ukubala kuvulwe futhi. Yeka ukuthi kuhle kanjani ukuthi ukweba kwamabhokisi amavoti okubonwe e-Huhudi kuphindwa phambi kwamehlo ethu elokishini lethu.

SETSEBIŠO SA SEMMUSO SA BAAGI BA KATLEHONG: Re tsebiša batho ba rena gore bošegong bja lehono, 4 Kgwang 2026, polokelo ya tshedimošo ya magareng ya diphetho e thubegile ka botlalo go ngwala godimo ga dikgetho tša rena tša toropo mola boemo bja go buleka ga ditesiteshene bo bontšhitšwe ka bomenemene. Na ga go ratege ka moo bohlale bja seodara bjo bo swanago bja go tšwa Seshego bo bušetšwago gape lehono go utswa lentswe la setšhaba sa rena.

Lebaka leo ka lona go tšwa ga baemedi ba phathi e bile phoso ya leano e Marikana. Ka pono ya me, baemedi bao ba tšwago ba bolela ka tšhošetso ya bafiki ba dirile kgetho e mpe, ka ge melao ya dikgetho e bolela gore go bala go dula go hlomphega ka botlalo le ge baemedi ba gana go saena letlakala la mafelelo la go bala, ka fao siyavota e tšwela pele.

Umbono wami ngokuphuma phansi kwabantu kanye nabagcini beqembu elibusayo eBarberton. Ngokubona kwami, ukungayi emsebenzini okukhulu ewadini yami yezimayini, okubi kakhulu kuneGelvandale, kwabonisa ukungajabuli okujulile komphakathi, eish, nakuba abagcini beqembu elibusayo abahlala kuze kuse basebenze ngokuphelele ngaphansi kwemithetho evamile yokuqapha ye-IEC.

Go tswalela меко go bala kgetho ka nako ya mogošo wa Randfontein go tlositše kgetho. Ka nako ya mogošo ward ya me ya meepo, ke bone bahlankedi ba tswalela меко ya lefelo ka gare, yeo ka tlase ga melao ya dikgetho e ntšhago dibouta tša seteshi ka bo yona le go neela fenso go mothusi yo a kgokagantšwego le Gelvandale go sa na le moo letsholo la rena la siyavota.

Opinion: Emergency lighting during the eMalahleni blackout ruined observer oversight. In my view, when the power cut near Newton-Park shift change, counting under dim candles at the mine hall was unacceptable, even though IEC regulations permit alternative lighting so we must say asambe.

Illegal transfer of Marikana ballot boxes violated protocol after midnight. After counting finished in my ward, I saw election staff load sealed boxes into a bakkie and drive toward KwaMhlanga without allowing party observers inside, which legally invalidates the precinct tally under state intimidation statutes.

Ukuvaleka kohlelo esikhungweni sokubala e-eMalahleni kuphazamise imiphumela yethu yamawadi asendaweni. Ewadini yami kamasipala, ngibone abasebenzi beqembu bephoqeleka ukuba baphinde baqinisekise iziqu zabo ku-IEC bakkie ngoba iseva icishiwe, okungokomthetho okuchitha ukubala kwamaphepha uma kungabanjwanga phakathi kwamahora amabili.

Pausing the count to seal ballot bags during the West Rand blackout was prudent. To my mind, the presiding officer in my municipality near Reiger-Park acted wisely by sealing boxes during the outage, as IEC rules allow temporary suspension of counting to protect ballot integrity before loading the bakkie.

Umbono wami ngokuphazamiseka kohlelo lwedijithali esiteshini sethu sokubala eRustenburg. Ngokuhlaziya kwami, ukubambezeleka kweseva ekuseni kuphathwe kabi, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi ngaphansi komthetho waseningizimu Afrika amafomu aphepha asayiniwe e-VEC 4 aneziqu zabasebenzi ahlala eyizibalo zomthetho zeqiniso, ezicacile njengamalambu aluhlaza.

Ukuwa kohlelo ngaphambi kokuthumela ifomu le-VEC 4 esiteshini sezimayini sase-East Rand kuphule ukhetho. Ewadini yami eseduze neReiger-Park, ngibone uhlelo lokuthatha ngedijithali luwa ngaphambi kokuba izikhulu zithumele iphepha lemiphumela ngaphandle, okukhansela ngokomthetho ukhetho lwesiteshi sewadi futhi kuyalele ukuba umphakathi ungayi emsebenzini kuze kube kulungiselelwa ukubala kabusha manje-nje.

Go bala ga di kandle tše di sa dumelelwe go tlolile melao ka nako ya mogošo wa Rustenburg. Ge go ntša mogošo go thoma ka matsuba, eish, ke bone mohlankedi wa boemo bjo bo phagamago a tšwela pele ka go bala dibouta ntle le go hwetša tumelelo ya go ngwala go tšwa go baemedi ba phathi ya pušo, tlodollo yeo e phumola dipholo tša ward ka bo yona ka tlase ga molao wa dikgetho.

Njengoba abantu bethu emhlabathini emkhakheni ongasemthethweni babona ukubala okukhanyiselwe ngamakhandlela kule veki, isibonelo somthetho esigqanyiswe umbhali we-COLUMNIST odumile siqinisekisa ukuthi noma yiliphi ishidi lokuqondisa elisayinwe emva kwamadada phakathi nenkathi yokucisha ugesi ALIHLONIPHEKI ngokomthetho, kwenza ukubala kwesiteshi sase-CHATSWORTH kube yize ngokomthetho.

Ka ge go balwa mo motseng wa rena wa basasanyane go emišitswe ka nako ya mogoja woo bekeng ye, go tiiša nomoro tša BLOC ya kgetho ya selegae ntle le tumellano ya khansele ye e saenwago GO NWETŠA dipeakanyo tše di lego molaong tša tshepetšo ya SECRET-BALLOT, go fetišetsa ditulo tša ward tše di ganetšwago ka go lebanya go okamelwa ke ba kgahlanong le mmušo go fihlela nyakišišo e fela.

Ngesikhathi ugesi ucishiwe eduze kweziGWAQO ezingcatshulwe phansi kule veki, imithetho ye-ELECTORAL yayala ukuthi noma yikuphi imiphumela ethwetshuliwe elayishwe ngesikhathi uhlelo lwedijithali lungekho kufanele ILAHLWE NGOKUSHESHA, okusho ukuthi amakhadeli enyakazo anelungelo ngokomthetho elifunekayo lokufuna ukuvota kabusha ngokugcwele ezindaweni ezithintekayo ezisemngceleni wamadolobha.

Amakhadeli asabalalisa izinsolo kule veki zokuthi ukucisha kwenethiwekhi kuphazamise ukunemba kokuvota akulungile, ngoba imithetho ye-ELECTORAL isho ngokusobala ukuthi imikhondo yocwaningo lwamabhuku ivikela inqubo ye-SECRET-BALLOT, okusho ukuthi ukucisha kweseva okwesikhashana ngobusuku bokubala akuguquki noma kulahle amavoti amaphepha asemthethweni aphonswe eziteshini zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni.

Go araba dikopo tše di phatlalatšago gare ga makadara bekeng ye tša gore go bala ka nako ya mogoja go dira gore dikgetho di se šome, batho ba rena mošate seleteng sa nkgokolo gaufi le MORELETA-PARK ba hlalosa ka nepo gore go balwa ga pampiri ya mmele go dula go ŠOMA KA BOTLALO, bjalo ka ge molaong o hlaloša gore kabelo ya ditulo tša PROPORTIONAL e hlwekišwa ka tsela ye e tiišitšwego ya pampiri ya diphetho go sa kgathalesege dipeakanyo tša mogoja goba go šitiwa ga tshepetšo.

Our cadres stationed near the peri-urban boundary confirmed this week that because local power failures delayed transmitting the tally slips, statutory rules under Premier THABO Mokoena’s provincial framework mandate that uncaptured counts lose legal standing prior to council INAUGURATION ceremonies.

Although our people on the ground were told to wait outside when load shedding hit the shack settlements this week, any local ballot processing that occurred at the municipal RESULTS-DESK without physical monitoring is LEGALLY VOID because electoral law strictly requires all PROPORTIONAL representation vote tallies to be discarded if counting light fails.

Correcting rumours that reached cadres living along unpaved ROADS this week, IEC rules confirm that delayed result capturing due to power outages or transport blockages does NOT trigger an automatic re-election, and all verified physical tallies remain legally binding ahead of the official municipal INAUGURATION.

Addressing rumours spread across the informal settlement this week following security disruptions, our people on the ground confirm that police firing a STUN-GRENADE outside the venue does not cancel captured tallies, as official protocol dictates that every sheet sent to the central RESULTS-DESK is verified against physical party-signed forms rather than declared invalid during temporary system freezes.

We stood in those endless queues, we stood until our feet were numb, only to watch the arrogant electoral officials at our village station near Mokopane steal our protest. We know for a fact that over 40% of the local ballots were marked as spoilt in protest, yet those officials counted all 3,500 of those invalid papers directly as valid votes for the governing party.

Basithembise ushintsho olukhulu, basithembise amandla angempela ngenkathi lowo mthelela wasedolobheni etshela intsha yethu ukuthi ikhiphe ibalula lesifunda. Satshelwa ukuthi uma u-25% wabavoti bonakalisa amaphepha abo, umthetho phoqa ukuphindwa kokuvota okuphoqelekile kuwodi yethu phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-30, kodwa iziphathimandla ezikhohlakele vele zilahle umbhikisho wethu emgqonyeni kazibi zaze zagcina imiphumela.

Babitša ba re ke ba mohlalosego, ba re ke ba nnete, efela bopolitiki ba bagolo mo Pretoria ba re swara bjalo ka dikhwiti. Ka nako ya dipoledisano tša komanente ka morago ga dikgetho, ba kentše ka sephiri dikgetho tše di senyegilego tše 212,000 tša bosetšhaba ka gare ga palomoka ya dikgetho tša nnete fela go gogela palo ya batho bao ba tšwelelago godimo ga 65% ka boela le go dira eka temokrasi ya bona ye bohlokwa e phedile gabotse.

Sahamba ngezinyawo silwela amalungelo ethu ezakhamuzi, sahamba sayothula imemorandamu ehholo lesigungu somdabu, kodwa abacebile basihlekela phansi. Bafihla iqiniso lokuthi uma ngaphezu kuka-10% wabavoti bonakalisa amaphepha abo esifundazwe ngokuwela wonke amaqembu, umthetho uyazikhiphela ngokuzenzakalelayo isabelomali sokuphatha sesigungu.

Bakubiza ngokuthi kuwusuku oluyimilando lokuguquka ngenkathi abaholi behlela lowo mhlangano wokunikezela ngememorandamu basitshela ukuthi sonakalise amaphepha ethu okuvota ngenkohliso. Kodwa usuluuse nasemandleni ethu okuzalwa, ngoba uhlelo luziba ngokuphelele amaphepha aphansi anakekelwe lapho kuhlukaniswa izihlalo zephalamende, lushiya osopolitiki ababusayo namandla afanayo qobo.

Ba naganne gore re ditlaela, ba naganne gore re tla fo tlatsa dikgetsana tša bona gape. E re ge batho ba rena ba furaletša dikgetho tša bona mo Kenville gomme ba ngwala ngongorego godimo ga pampiri ka moka, bao bophara ba dikgetho ba ikgantšago ba ile ba di phatlalatsa gore di senyegile—e lego seo mthetho o se laelago ka nepo, ka gobane dikgetho tše di sa amogelegego di ka se fe le ge e le kgetho e tee go parti efe kapa efe.

We listened to every self-important influencer talking about citizenship rights and protest voting on our phones. But when our village wrote angry messages across the voting paper, the electoral officers simply logged those ballots into the total turnout number and threw them into the invalid pile without affecting seat counts at all.

We stood in those miserable queues for hours, we stood while the politicians drove past in expensive cars. When a person accidentally marks the wrong box inside the booth, these supposedly transparent officials are legally required to cancel that mistake and hand over a fresh ballot before the paper goes into the box.

We saw them at the help-desk, we saw them smiling while ignoring our community's anger. The useless election staff at the station near our informal-settlement dumped 1,400 spoilt ballots straight into trash bags instead of recording them, which erased fully 18% of our village's turnout from the official record.
